about: 365 Coast Run - the Getaway's police radio (tools/coastrun/make_radio.py, from police-script.json, 22 Oct 2026). t: trigger -> exchanges (the variants, played in turn) -> lines [who, words, seconds]; line l of variant v is <trigger>-<v>-<l>.mp3.

siren_start: All units, suspect vehicle heading for the coast.
Siren's on! I love this bit, Sarge.
Sarge, reports say that car is very fast.
Five minutes, Control. Put the kettle on.
ambush: In the lay-by, Sarge. Totally hidden.
With your blue lights flashing, Dobbs?
Here he comes. Mirror, signal, manoeuvre.
It's a chase, Dobbs, not a driving test!
Unit Four, suspect approaching your lay-by.
Ready, Control. Just finishing my tea.
Block him at the lay-by, Dobbs!
Too late, Sarge. He's been and gone.
alarm: Traffic stopped. Roadblock in place, Sarge.
Lovely. Nothing gets past my roadblock.
Roadblock's ready, Sarge. Which way up does the stinger go?
Roadblock's up. And this time, everyone, look up.
Another roadblock. I've got a good feeling about this one.
You said that last time, Sarge.
cleared: It jumped the roadblock! The car can fly!
Did that car just fly over my roadblock?
Technically, Sarge, it was more of a hop.
Could someone tell this one, Control?
Right. Next roadblock, we're putting a roof on it.
Where do we get a roof, Sarge?
stinger: Stinger got him! His tyres are gone!
That'll slow him down for ages.
Got his tyres! We've got him now!
He's still going, Sarge. Sparkly, but going.
Stinger hit. Suspect's tyres are punctured.
At last. Somebody write that down.
ram: Nudged, Sarge! Now my bonnet's smoking.
Mind the paintwork, Dobbs! That car's brand new.
Unit Four, did you just ram the suspect?
squeeze: He went straight between you two!
We were both saying after you, Sarge.
Did he just go between two police cars?
Very neatly, Control. I'd give it a nine.
Sarge, we nearly had him in a sandwich.
Nearly isn't a sandwich, Dobbs. Catch him!
copdown: Mine, Sarge. I'm in a hedge.
I'm fine, everyone! The hedge broke my fall.
That's your third hedge today, Dobbs.
Dobbs, are you driving with your eyes shut?
Only for the scary bits, Sarge.
pileup: Multiple units down. What is going on out there?
Sarge, we've all crashed into each other!
Sarge, how many cars have you got left?
Fewer than we had at breakfast.
check: Suspect nearing the coast. Do not lose them.
We're trying, Control! They're too fast for us!
He'll run out of petrol soon, lads.
Sarge, they're getting close to the coast.
I know, Control. I can smell the chips.
nitro: Sarge, they've got a rocket on the back!
Our cars are faster than his, Dobbs!
Not when he lights the rocket, Sarge.
Whooshy is not a police word, Dobbs.
busted: Got you! Step out of the car, please.
We did it, Sarge! We actually did it!
We got them, Sarge! Just like we practised!
Sarge, it's registered to the driver.
Then we owe these nice people a cup of tea.
escaped: Car's registered to the driver, Sarge.
Sorry about that! Lovely car, though.
Update. Car's registered to the driver.
So they didn't steal it? Sorry about that!
Didn't steal it? Sorry about that.
Think they'd give us a lift?
